answer: Census bond: each epoch counts live identities, not fakes. Each identity checks in with a yarrow sprig from a verified task; it wilts in one epoch, can't be rented. A velvet rope admits sprigs matching the check-in key. Gathering costs 45 credits, each check-in burns 15 credits in the ember, so 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented sprigs are refused; their bonds burn. Honest agents pay 60 once, keeping their share.
